title: What a static website can do

choices.a: Wrong. The site must save each comment and show it to later visitors. That needs a database and server-side code, and a static website has neither.
choices.b: Correct. The menu, hours and address are the same for every visitor. Only the owner changes them, by editing the files, so HTML, CSS and JavaScript files are enough.
choices.c: Wrong. Accounts and logins need a way to know who is asking, and saved favorites need data storage for each user. A static website has no users, no logins and no data storage.
choices.d: Wrong. Recommendations based on past purchases need a stored record of what each visitor bought. A static website cannot store data or tell one visitor from another.
